blocks.text: Apartment interior design in Barcelona, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 108 m²

parts.html: A 108 m² apartment in Barcelona. The studio produced the interior design project with 3D visualization, the technical documentation and a detailed cost estimate covering construction and finishing work, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures and lighting. We then carried out the turnkey renovation and installed the custom furniture.

The project covers the kitchen-living room, bedroom, walk-in closets, entrance hall, bathroom and storage areas. The same materials repeat in every room: light marble-look tiles, warm walnut, dark veined stone, light upholstered panels and thin brass inlays.

The wall behind the living room sofa is made of tall light-colored upholstered panels with narrow mirror and brass strips between them. Next to it is the dining area with a glass table. Above it and the passage to the entrance hall runs a ceiling of walnut slats with built-in spotlights, and the slats continue down the wall.

The kitchen with an island stands by the windows. The fronts are beige gloss and handleless, the oven is built into the island, and the backsplash is veined stone. The island has a white countertop and a wooden bar shelf, with pendants in white shades and metal frames above it. Behind the kitchen, the TV wall is clad in dark stone.

The entrance hall has wall-to-wall cabinets with walnut fronts and dark vertical inserts. The side walls are clad in large dark marble-look tiles, with an upholstered bench in the middle. Along the passage there are white gloss panels and two narrow lit walnut niches, and the doors sit flush with the walls, without casings.

In one of the rooms, the wall behind the sofa is made of upholstered panels framed in walnut, with two sconces, and the door is hidden in the walnut paneling. The bathroom has white marble-look floor tiles, a hexagonal mosaic with gold inserts on the wall by the bathtub, and a long wall-hung vanity with two sinks opposite.
Further down the page you will find the visualizations, photos of the apartment after the renovation and photos of the furniture installation stage by stage.
